description: Real capture (2026-09-14, SDK 0.3.272 / CLI 2.1.272). Same as sdk272-bg-subagent-no-idle, but the host called query.interrupt() 1.5s after the lead turn result, while only the background subagent was live (a Stop pressed with no foreground turn). The interrupt resolved {still_queued: []} and produced NO result, NO idle and no interrupt_receipt on the stream; the subagent kept running (perTaskStopAffordance), then the normal completion wake followed: background_tasks_changed:0, terminal task signals, running, wake result, idle.
